cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 pattern - Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 and Cocamide MEA #9 (Sodium Xylenesulfonate #3 hydrotrope); late TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate #17 is an emulsion-carrier anionic; no reset intent ('reinigt sanft').

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 pattern - early silicone Dimethiconol #7 (before Parfum #12) plus Dimethicone #13, cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #14, pearlizer Glycol Distearate #10 and Cocamide MEA #9, with light humectant/comfort routes (Butylene Glycol #23, Aloe #24). C2: cleansing strength does not lower conditioning.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Humectant support is weak and late; the C2 reference had prominent Panthenol/Glycerin.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W1 analogue - silicones (#7, #13) plus cationic guar #14 and pearlizer #10 in an effective SLES/betaine base without a rich 2-in-1 architecture.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Persistent silicone/guar deposition bounded by effective reset (W1).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: High needs multiple converging persistent systems with limited reset; the early dimethiconol plus a second silicone and pearlizer make high the realistic neighbor.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: problem-led anti-dandruff / itchy-dry-scalp product ('Anti-Schuppen Wirkung mit Pirocton Olamin', 'gegen Kopfhautjucken', 'Beruhigende Pflege') with recognized active Piroctone Olamine #6 (7.2).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: recognized active -> scalp_active compatible. Unblind: anti-dandruff and itchy/dry scalp claims -> scalp_active.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: itch/dry-scalp comfort is part of the scalp_active role (never repeat primary, §8; Appendix A); 'Feuchtigkeit' refers to the scalp, not lengths.

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: supported anti-dandruff formula with problem-led positioning (§9).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicitly positioned for dry, itchy scalp ('Beruhigende Pflege' in name, 'gegen Kopfhautjucken', 'Beruhigend bei trockener, juckender Kopfhaut', 'stärkt die Kopfhautbarriere') with a moderate buffered cleansing base, Aloe #24 and Oryza Sativa Bran Extract #30. Counter-signals: Menthol #16 and fragrance (not a veto in an explicitly anti-itch product, §10); comfort routes are late; claimed ceramides/cactus/vitamin E are absent from the INCI.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Menthol, fragrance, late comfort routes, claim-formula mismatch.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C high: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse ideal; dandruff target (T6) lifts nothing. T4: W neighbor high would make normal acceptable -> flag normal; fine would become not_suited but T6 floors it at acceptable -> no flag; C neighbor moderate would make coarse acceptable -> flag coarse.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: E2 'Anti-Schuppen Wirkung' / 'schuppenfreie Kopfhaut' on the exact manufacturer page (E1 moderate; product name has no Schuppen term) + supported -> pass; confidence moderate. S-SENSITIVE: E2 'juckende Kopfhaut' passes, scalpComfortTarget targeted passes, but no prominent E4 comfort route (prominent = before Parfum #12; Aloe #24 is late and unlisted) -> fails. S-DRY: E2 'trockener ... Kopfhaut' passes, targeted passes, but no prominent E4 humectant (Butylene Glycol #23 unlisted and late) -> fails. S-FAIL does not apply because dandruff qualifies. S-FOCUS: scalp_active -> no mismatch.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular = schuppen expectation. I3: no neighbor.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Claim-formula conflict: claims cite a Ceramide complex, cactus extract and vitamin E that are not in the canonical INCI. §2 requires blocking or lowering confidence only if the conflict could change a property/projection; none of the missing ingredients is an E4-listed route, so values stand, but the INCI may be an older/other-market version.

Failed sensitive/dry gates are silent when another specialist target passes: S-FAIL only fires if 'no other specialist target qualifies', so a product positioned primarily for dry/itchy scalp loses those targets without any review flag.
T4 with T6: the fine neighbor (W high -> not_suited) is floored back to acceptable by T6, so no flag; T4 says to evaluate 'after T6 is applied', which was followed.
C2 humectant leg is weak here (late butylene glycol/aloe); applied C2 because early silicone + cationic + pearlizer are present.
